entities.summary: Georgios Dedas is a retired Greek professional basketball player and professional basketball coach. He was most recently the head coach for Filou Oostende of the BNXT League. During his playing career, at a height of 2.00 m tall and a weight of 100 kg (220 lbs.), he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions.
